purpose: Measure reduction in non-behavioral gate churn without weakening correctness gates.

retired_or_adjusted_gates.replacement: responsibility-based module boundaries plus Xenon complexity budgets
5000 Python lines or 100 Python files plus explicit change plans
C absolute with B module and average ceilings

metric_definitions.contract_red_test_runs: Intentional failing test runs that establish a task contract.
metric_definitions.focused_test_runs: Focused verifier or test invocations during implementation.
metric_definitions.broad_verification_runs: Full, CI-equivalent, release, or similarly broad profiles.
metric_definitions.duplicate_broad_runs: Broad profiles repeated on the same source and configuration state.
metric_definitions.non_behavioral_gate_findings: Blocking findings whose remediation changed no behavior or contract.
metric_definitions.gate_remediation_lines: Added plus deleted lines used only to remediate non-behavioral findings.
metric_definitions.verification_wall_seconds: Measured wall time across recorded verifier invocations.
metric_definitions.style_only_commits: Commits with no behavior, contract, test, schema, documentation-meaning, or generator-input change.

tasks.notes: First post-policy baseline. Six blocking check groups changed no product behavior: two focused import/style checks plus four generic Agent Maintainer CI-profile groups. GitHub CI found two behavioral Python 3.10 compatibility defects: new tomllib imports lacked the existing tomli fallback, and Xenon was not an explicit cross-version development dependency. Broad runs followed implementation, review fixes, or CI compatibility fixes; none repeated an unchanged source/configuration state.

K1A final local measurement, including a clean Python 3.10 phase run, four accepted reviewer contract findings, and one clean-checkout sdist determinism defect found by CI. Five non-behavioral findings narrowed Ruff to phase-owned files, isolated pytest from a stale local Tach plugin, updated the wrapper-policy test, and corrected two test/import mistakes during reviewer remediation. One unchanged-state broad pass was duplicated when just vc reran just v before the package build; future tasks should use the package-only step after an already-green just v. Review-token attribution is pending and was not retried.

Final local K2 measurement before integration CI. Recorded verification wall time is 13.6% lower than K1A and 94.9% lower than K1, with no duplicate broad run or style-only commit. Non-behavioral findings and remediation lines increased: two Xenon-B findings caused most of the 230-line structural rewrite, while environment/path invocation mistakes, Ruff forms, one MyPy import form, one Pyright interpreter path, one over-broad privacy assertion, and one attempt to collect later-task oracle adapters made up the remainder. Six accepted final-review findings and two implementation defects found while remediating them count as blocking findings but not non-behavioral churn. The phase-owned suite remains explicit because four K1 oracle adapters intentionally depend on quarantined runtime until their K3 owners replace them.

K3 merged through PR #320 as f5d988621f0cf3e130cf02ddc3a3681f9822be3d after Python 3.10 passed in 51 s and Python 3.14 passed in 56 s. Final qualification includes 99 phase-owned tests, a 100000-call streaming build, exact distribution checks, and isolated installed-wheel first-build/no-change smoke. The single final reviewer reported 10 findings and all 10 were accepted: source-local replacement, allowance provenance, bounded promotion digest, streaming hydration, interrupted promotion recovery, bounded rewrite detection, moving-tail catch-up, lease fencing, immutable visible dimensions, and durable progress. CI Python 3.10 exposed environment-sensitive per-fingerprint work up to 313.673 ms p95. Collision-free initial hydration now marks rows canonical directly and resolves only actual duplicate fingerprint groups. The final local 100000-call run was 10.853 s with 33.407 ms writer p95 across 503 transactions. Duplicate broad runs and style-only commits remained zero. The arbitrary 600-line gate was retired after it demanded non-behavioral splitting; Xenon complexity budgets remain blocking. The closeout broad run also found preserved .idea state was not ignored; adding .idea/ to .gitignore removed that false scope blocker without touching user files. Reviewer token metrics are pending because the one allowed finish call returned no payload.

K4 merged through PR #322 as a38bf4440ae04b34d9197628378f09c05fd2c060. The query suite has 25 tests including a fixed 100000-call workload, frozen accounting-oracle equivalence, named EXPLAIN plans, concurrent writer snapshot stability, UTC-offset windows, hostile cursors, partial-measure truth grading, and deterministic phase attribution. The one final reviewer reported six findings and all six were accepted. Common/comparison/concentration p95 improved from the review-fix checkpoint of 265.978/647.280/909.854 ms to the final 110.724/135.543/66.826 ms after eliminating redundant non-empty result scans. Initial CI found one non-behavioral host-sensitive K3 ingest benchmark failure on Python 3.10; the unchanged 50 ms budget now runs once on Python 3.14 while both interpreters retain all functional, typing, privacy, scope, release, and K4 query contracts. Final CI passed in 63 and 86 seconds. Focused runs are 60.9% lower, blocking findings 41.7% lower, and non-behavioral findings 35.3% lower than K3; broad runs are unchanged, and duplicate broad runs and style-only commits remain zero. Gate-remediation lines increased because the maintained Xenon complexity budget required two responsibility extractions in the new planner and validator; the arbitrary file-length gate remained retired. Reviewer token metrics are pending because the one allowed finish call returned no payload.

K5 merged through PR #323 as 7d51a17acbd4a7648674ffa56c242a8a9b32eec3 with rebuild-stable logical-selector evidence and a persistent post-commit generation journal/live stream. The phase-owned suite has 42 evidence/live tests within 142 total kernel tests after adding a CI regression contract. The 100000-call evidence first-page workload measured 67.032 ms median and 68.387 ms p95 against the 500 ms budget. One final reviewer reported five findings and all five were accepted: publication identity under generation reuse, key-based stream privacy, future Last-Event-ID rejection, request-bound cursor limits, and exact call/tool attribution. Initial CI passed on Python 3.14 but found one non-behavioral Python 3.10 test-fixture defect: internal thread ordering selected a valid thread with no timeline rows. The fixture now selects a stable logical thread proven to have at least two timeline events; an exact disposable Python 3.10.20 gate passed all 141 then-existing tests in 29.86 seconds. Corrected CI passed on Python 3.10 in 75 seconds and Python 3.14 in 90 seconds. A subsequent docs-only rerun exposed an inherited CI wiring defect: the functional matrix ignored the ingest performance test and then re-added it through an explicit shell glob, so the host-sensitive 100000-call benchmark ran under broad-suite contention and failed at 59.743 ms. A contract-red policy test now forbids the wildcard; both functional lists name the seven ingest tests and the unchanged 50 ms budget remains in its dedicated Python 3.14 step. The exact local functional command passed 141 tests in 20.14 seconds with only the dedicated performance test excluded. Final corrected CI passed on Python 3.10 in 56 seconds and Python 3.14 in 79 seconds. Five non-behavioral findings were a future-schema test constant, two focused Ruff forms, fixture selection, and CI performance-step wiring. Broad runs followed implementation, reviewer fixes, package qualification, CI findings, or compatibility qualification, with no unchanged-state repetition. The pinned Scalene run 20260727T015044Z-fc265f11 was incomplete because it emitted no JSON profile, so the identical unprofiled benchmark remains authoritative and no hotspot claim is made. Reviewer token attribution remains pending.

K6 merged through PR #324 as 0fd6dc875480bc9e6ab0cacffa9d23fc053af74f after Python 3.10 passed in 58 seconds and Python 3.14 passed in 82 seconds. It implements one shared kernel application service, exactly six MCP tools, the frozen /api/kernel/v1 loopback API, the retained operational CLI, deterministic schemas and plugin identity, atomic same-version bundle replacement, and exact K6 disposition/scope transitions. The final post-review kernel profile passed 172 tests in 35.31 seconds with Ruff, Mypy, Pyright, maintainability, manifests, release safety, and privacy contracts clean. Warm status/query p95 measured 0.514/0.912 ms on the identical synthetic adapter workload. Agent-perf run 20260727T023958Z-652240e6 could not start because the repository environment does not include pinned Scalene 2.3.0; no profile or hotspot claim is made. Exact wheel/sdist checks and an isolated no-dependency six-tool MCP handshake passed. Public PyPI 0.25.1 independently passed its retained installed-package smoke. The single final reviewer reported five findings and all five were accepted: stale refresh recovery, schema-before-side-effect validation, JSON-RPC/MCP envelope negotiation, sanitized SQLite failures, and manifest-inclusive bundle attestation. Reviewer token attribution is pending after the one bounded metrics call timed out. One duplicate broad verifier occurred when just v immediately reran the already-green just vp profile. Non-behavioral remediation was limited to Ruff import forms, namespace-package Mypy configuration, and responsibility-based validator extraction required by the maintained complexity budget; no style-only commit occurred.

K7 is in progress. Contract-red collection proved the Console owner was absent before implementation. Current evidence includes exact five-area routing, read-only navigation with byte-identical SQLite files, deterministic 38.5 KB source assets, 20 passing desktop/mobile browser flows with two intentional cross-project skips, a 0.562-second synthetic warm reopen with zero refresh requests, exact per-row evidence links, all allowlisted presets, explicit single-refresh orchestration, stale/live/retry preservation, exact distribution checks, isolated installed-wheel Console serving, and public 0.25.1 installed Console reference assets. Manual browser inspection found and fixed one NaN metric and one duplicate initial-generation announcement. The single final reviewer reported nine findings and all nine were accepted: row-associated evidence, valid presets, live publication identity/reconnect proof, dark-mode contrast, CI installed smokes, Python interpreter portability, full application typechecking, zero-cache math, and working retry controls. Three non-behavioral findings were two Playwright locator assumptions and deterministic assets not rebuilt before an early broad check. Reviewer token attribution is pending because no structured Usage Tracker review record is callable in this task; no analysis or refresh was started solely for metrics. Agent-perf Node run 20260727T032753Z-771bda4e was incomplete because Node emitted no CPU profile and also exposed a host-path quoting defect; only the two generated untracked CPU artifacts were removed, no hotspot or speedup claim is made. CI and merge remain pending.
